svg.text: Its only copper is a 0.278 mm2 F.Cu fragment with ZERO vias - a floating
extension of the pad, not a ground connection. Adjacent pads leave a 0.100 mm
exit lane; yellow tracks block it east and west.
purple = U4.12 (VDD) and U4.14 (DCC_SW), the two blocking neighbours
yellow = F.Cu tracks orange ring = foreign via green = GND copper
